title: Las Flores de Tapalpa, MEXITV
comment: flores-tapalpa (MEXITV): comedor de una hacienda antigua en Tapalpa, Jalisco, durante una cena. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.HORTENSIA_SALAZAR: Mexican woman, proud widow who owns an old hacienda, 60 years old, fair skin, short ash-blonde hair styled in stiff waves, thin lips with coral lipstick, a navy-blue silk blouse with a high collar, a large gold brooch, gold bracelets, a long black skirt, her hands empty.
chars.VALENTINA_SALAZAR: Mexican woman, her daughter, 27 years old, light skin, long straight light-brown hair with a side part, sweet expressive face, small pearl stud earrings, a simple burgundy long-sleeve dress, her hands empty.
chars.GAEL_ITURBE: Mexican man, flower seller at the market, 30 years old, warm brown skin, short curly black hair, clean-shaven, a kind calm face, a clean white cotton shirt buttoned to the neck with sleeves rolled, dark trousers, simple brown shoes, his hands empty.
chars.PATRICIO_ITURBE: Mexican man, powerful landowner of the neighboring estate, 64 years old, brown skin, white hair combed back, a neat white mustache, a dark-grey three-piece suit with a white shirt and no tie, a black felt hat, polished black shoes, his hands empty.

locs.LOC_COMEDORTAPALPA: Dining room of an old hacienda in Tapalpa, Jalisco, at night: dark carved wooden table with a white lace tablecloth, antique porcelain plates, crystal glasses, a silver candelabra with lit candles, a vase of fresh flowers, white adobe walls, dark wooden ceiling beams, an arched doorway to the hall, warm candlelight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
